enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +9: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +9 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Vitality +20: Passive: +20 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Acid Resistance +40: Passive: +40 Enhancement bonus to your Acid Resistance.
Acid Absorption +20%: Passive: 20% Enhancement Bonus to Acid Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Proof Against Poison +10: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +10 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 11 + their Fortitude save).

Power Store: This item collects and stores magical energy. Any spellcaster can use this energy to partially power their spells. All spells cast while using this item receive an enhancement bonus of -10% to their spell point costs.
